collection.title: Chrysler Sebring Coupe 1995 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chrysler Sebring Coupe 1995 to 2006 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
